claims.statement: JavaFile automatically constructs standard Java package directory structure by splitting package name on '.' and resolving each component, creating missing intermediate directories via Files.createDirectories().
JavaFile enforces UTF-8 encoding as an invariant; host charset and explicit charset parameters are ignored in favor of StandardCharsets.UTF_8.

JavaFile uses a two-pass approach with NULL_APPENDABLE as a sentinel Appendable for the first pass to collect import information without writing output, then performs a second pass through a real code writer.
writeToPath(Path) and writeToFile(File) return the actual destination Path or File to which source was written, enabling callers to verify output location.
writeTo(Path) and writeFile(File) return void; they perform identical directory creation logic to writeToPath/writeToFile but do not expose the destination.
JavaFile throws IllegalArgumentException if the target path exists as a file (not a directory), preventing accidental overwrites.
Files with empty package names are written directly to the target directory without creating subdirectories.
